units.source_text: 我在远离城市的乡村长大。

en.t: I grew up in a village far from the city.

units.source_text: 对于祖父的葬礼，夸张一点说，全村五十户人家也都为之哀伤痛哭。

en.t: At my grandfather's funeral, to put it a little dramatically, all fifty households in the village grieved and wept for him.

units.source_text: 送殡行列从村中走过时，街头巷尾都挤满了村里人。

en.t: When the funeral procession passed through the village, every street and alley was crowded with villagers.

units.source_text: 我护送着灵柩从他们前面经过，妇女们哭出声来了。

en.t: As I escorted the coffin past them, the women began to cry aloud.

units.source_text: 我不时听见她们说：真可怜啊，真可怜啊！

en.t: From time to time I heard them saying, How pitiful, how pitiful!

units.source_text: 我只是感到羞涩，变得拘谨了。

en.t: I only felt embarrassed and became stiff and self-conscious.

units.source_text: 我走过一个街头，那里的妇女又抄近路，比我先行绕到另一个街头上，发出同样的凄厉哭声。

en.t: After I passed one street corner, the women there took a shortcut again, went around ahead of me to another corner, and raised the same piercing cries of grief.
